controller_spec.description: Deterministic instance-adaptive HH controller over a frozen portfolio with interpretable structure tests and stagnation-triggered switching.
controller_spec.name: det_tsp_hh_oracle_portfolio_v4

edge_skew_correction.action: force two_cluster_bottleneck_heuristic when bottleneck-score >= 0.45 else force nearest_neighbor_trap_heuristic
edge_skew_correction.trigger_if: edge-length skew in current tour >= 0.62 AND stagnation_length >= 2

late_stage_refinement.policy: prefer compact improvement: do not change heuristic unless stagnation_switch trigger fires; if current heuristic is grid_like/candidate_pruned, keep it; otherwise allow at most one switch to stagnation_switch_heuristic

perturbation_escalation.escalate_to: annealed_multi_start if (distance_cv >= 0.45 or edge_weight_type in ['EUC_2D']) else edge_preserving_restart

temperature_tuning.temperature_scale: temperature_scale * (0.9 if grid_likeness >= 0.35 else 1.0) * (0.95 if bottleneck-score >= 0.6 else 1.0)

offsets.candidate_limit_offset: candidate_limit_offset if grid_likeness >= 0.25 else (0 if time_budget_used < 0.45 else -1)

stagnation_switch.selector_tie_break: if multiple tests fire, prefer earlier in deterministic_selection_order; only override to two_cluster_bottleneck when bottleneck-score >= 0.58
stagnation_switch.trigger_if: stagnation_length >= stagnation_threshold OR (recent_improvement_rate < low_improvement_threshold AND accepted_swaps == 0)

restart_budgeting.max_restarts: 1 + (restart_offset if stagnation_length >= 3 else 0) + (1 if failed_perturbation_count >= failed_perturbation_threshold else 0)
restart_budgeting.time_pressure_rule: if time_budget_used >= 0.85, reduce restarts to 0 unless stagnation_length >= 2*stagnation_threshold

corridor.use_if: corridor_score >= 0.43 AND grid_likeness <= 0.22 AND (coordinate_spread_norm >= 0.22 OR mst_length_norm >= 0.67)

nearest_neighbor_trap.use_if: nearest-neighbor-trap-score >= 0.27 OR nn_distance_cv >= 0.66 OR (distance_cv >= 0.58 AND nn_distance_mean_norm <= 0.06)
